name: meta-ads-mcp
description: Official Meta Ads MCP access plus focused Southeast Rippa Ads and Instagram tools.

interface.shortDescription: Access Meta Ads and Southeast Rippa Instagram through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Meta's official Ads MCP server and focused local Instagram tools for insights, media and Direct conversations. Advertising or Instagram message writes require an explicit user request. The access token remains in macOS Keychain.
capabilities: Campaign, ad set and ad analysis
Explicitly requested ad and Instagram message operations
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze active Meta ads through the official MCP server and access @southeastrippa through the local Instagram MCP tools. Only make ad changes or send Instagram messages when I explicitly request the exact action.
